parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 e1 1/0/0 channel.template: set chassis fpc [parameter1] pic [parameter2] e1 [parameter3] channel-group [parameter4] timeslots [parameter5]
set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 e1 1/0/0 channel.command: set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 e1 1/0/0 channel-group 1 timeslots 1-31
set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 e1 1/0/0 channel.explanation: 配置机箱中FPC、PIC、E1接口的通道组和时间槽。

set interfaces t1-1/0/0:1 encapsulation.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型为PPP。

set interfaces t1-1/0/0:1 clocking exter.explanation: 配置接口的时钟源为外部。

set services diagnostics tdr interface t.template: set services diagnostics tdr interface [parameter1] interval [parameter2]
set services diagnostics tdr interface t.command: set services diagnostics tdr interface t1-1/0/0:1 interval 20
set services diagnostics tdr interface t.explanation: 配置TDR（Time Domain Reflectometry）诊断的接口和间隔时间。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 诊断间隔时间，单位为秒。

set services diagnostics tdr interface t.template: set services diagnostics tdr interface [parameter1] pattern [parameter2]
set services diagnostics tdr interface t.command: set services diagnostics tdr interface t1-1/0/0:1 pattern prbs15
set services diagnostics tdr interface t.explanation: 配置TDR诊断的接口和测试模式。
